standard_prerequisites.name: The notion of the topology induced by an injective map of a set into a topological space, and the weakest-topology characterisation

core_obligations: The candidate topology: the proof defines the family of preimages of opens under the injective map and checks the axioms of a topology, using that preimages preserve the empty set, the whole set, unions and intersections (proof lines 652-660).

Minimality: it then observes that any topology making the map continuous must contain every preimage of an open, so this family is the weakest such topology, which gives the equivalence with the first description (proof lines 660-676).

The closed-set description: the proof uses the identity expressing the preimage of a complement as the complement of the preimage, which converts the description by opens into the description by closed sets (proof lines 677-684).
Conclusion: the three descriptions of the statement all define the same topology (proof lines 684-685).
proof_roadmap: 先验证 {f^{-1}(U) : U 开} 构成 Y 上的拓扑（原像保持空集、全集、并与交）。
再由“f 连续”强制包含这些原像，得到它是最弱拓扑；用“补集的原像是原像的补集”把开集描述翻成闭集描述，三条等价。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the triple description of the topology induced by an injective map (author lemma at source lines 637-649, label lemma-induced): it is the weakest topology making the map continuous, its opens are the preimages of opens, and its closed sets are the preimages of closed sets. The proof (source lines 651-685) is a complete verification: the family of preimages is shown to satisfy the topology axioms (proof lines 652-660), minimality among topologies making the map continuous is checked (proof lines 660-676), and the closed-set description is obtained from the identity for preimages of complements (proof lines 677-684). The three descriptions are used as alternative definitions throughout the chapter's subsections on submersive maps. H2.
